description: Undo EVERY change of one batch in one call — e.g. a solver's layout of the week, written with batch='solver 2026-11-18'. Each event goes back to how it was before the batch's first change of it, field by field; a field somebody changed after the batch keeps their change, and 'kept' names those events, the fields and who. 'restored' lists the events put back. Anybody who may write in the project.

batch.description: The batch, as the writes named it.

confirmOverCeiling.description: true to let the rollback take a week over the ceiling — only for somebody who configures the project.
